answer_card.title: cisco.iosxr dependency bumps
answer_card.answer_md: cisco.iosxr now depends on **ansible.netcommon >= 8.1.0** (earlier versions had issues with ansible-core 2.19) and requires **ansible-core >= 2.16**.
